text:
{"guide": "Voice guide for Tobias Rennick

Written by the offline stand in (fixed rules over the measured numbers). It is not a language model. Edit it freely.

Sentences: short and blunt, about 5 words, with fragments allowed. The length stays even.
Paragraphs: two or three sentences.
Tone: relaxed but tidy. Rarely uses contractions. Write the full words.
Talking to the reader: often says you and we. Speaks from personal experience with I.
Questions and energy: seldom asks questions. Avoids exclamation marks.
Detail: uses concrete numbers often.
Sentences most often start with a plain subject.
Favourite words: every, money, late, first, fixed, work, month, minutes, calls, paid, real, answer.
Phrases that keep coming back: on tuesday.

Never invent facts, numbers or stories. If a line needs a real example, leave a bracket for the author."}
